children: On October 28, 2026, Nasdaq notified Alset that its common stock had closed below the $1.00 minimum bid price for 30 consecutive trading days, failing Nasdaq Marketplace Rule 5550(a)(2). The company has until April 26, 2027, to regain compliance by closing at or above $1.00 for at least 10 consecutive business days; the notice does not immediately affect its listing. Alset is considering options, including a previously announced 1-for-5 reverse stock split, and may qualify for an additional 180-day compliance period.
